calls.title: Rishi Kumar and James Shannon
calls.summary: The meeting outlined growth initiatives for the EMEA customer support team, focusing on hiring in France and the UK to better serve clients, emphasizing local support's strategic significance. Eneco's choice of self-hosting due to GDPR compliance was highlighted, alongside the need for improved metric governance, as over 150 metrics cause confusion. GrowthBook's ongoing AI integration aims to streamline experimentation workflows, while exceptional customer support is seen as a competitive advantage. Additionally, barriers to experimentation adoption were discussed, urging for cultural and tooling improvements to enhance scale and efficiency.
